key_evidence_spans: A 54-year-old woman with no significant medical or dental history presented with an expansile swelling on the right side of her face
Panoramic radiography showed a well-defined, unilocular radiolucent lesion with buccal and lingual cortical expansion in the posterior right mandible
There was no pain, paresthesia, or tooth mobility
The initial clinicoradiographic differential diagnosis included unicystic ameloblastoma and developmental odontogenic cysts, especially an odontogenic keratocyst
An excisional biopsy of the lesion was performed, and the specimen was submitted for histopathological examination
